zh.principle: **协议**：QUIC 传输协议（QUIC）。RFC 9000 §1 说明承载方式与目的：「QUIC packets are carried in UDP datagrams [UDP] to better facilitate deployment in existing systems and networks.」QUIC 因此是运行在 UDP 之上、自带安全与多路复用的传输协议，而不是 TCP 之上的一个加密层。
zh.why: 安全与传输参数一次协商：§1 写明「The QUIC handshake combines negotiation of cryptographic and transport parameters.QUIC integrates the TLS handshake [TLS13], although using a customized framing for protecting packets.」
zh.used: 保护职责由 RFC 9001 规定：「This document describes how QUIC [QUIC-TRANSPORT] is secured using TLS [TLS13].」并说明「QUIC [QUIC-TRANSPORT] assumes responsibility for the confidentiality and integrity protection of packets.」密钥有明确的丢弃时点：客户端首次发送 Handshake 包、服务器首次成功处理 Handshake 包时「MUST discard Initial keys」。
zh.broken: 版本协商是不受保护的一环：§12.1 记载「Version Negotiation packets have no cryptographic protection」，Retry 包只用 AEAD 函数防偶然修改；§6.2 对本版本留下「How to perform version negotiation is left as future work」的说明，即版本 1 没有可证明不被降级的版本协商。
zh.history:
RFC 9000 与配套的 RFC 9001 同为 2021 年 5 月的 Standards Track 文件（前者编辑为 J.Iyengar 与 M.Thomson，后者为 M.Thomson 与 S.Turner），两份头部都没有 Updates 或 Obsoletes 行；本文件定义的是「version 1 of QUIC」。

en.principle: **Protocol**: QUIC (QUIC 传输协议). Section 1 gives the carrier and the motive: "QUIC packets are carried in UDP datagrams [UDP] to better facilitate deployment in existing systems and networks." QUIC is thus a transport over UDP with security and multiplexing built in, not an encryption layer on top of TCP.
en.why: One handshake negotiates both halves: §1 states "The QUIC handshake combines negotiation of cryptographic and transport parameters. QUIC integrates the TLS handshake [TLS13], although using a customized framing for protecting packets."
en.used:
RFC 9001 carries the protection rules: "This document describes how QUIC [QUIC-TRANSPORT] is secured using TLS [TLS13]." and "QUIC [QUIC-TRANSPORT] assumes responsibility for the confidentiality and integrity protection of packets." Key discarding is explicit: a client and a server "MUST discard Initial keys" at the first Handshake packet sent or successfully processed.

en.broken: Version negotiation is the unprotected part: §12.1 records that "Version Negotiation packets have no cryptographic protection", Retry packets only carry an AEAD integrity function against modification, and §6.2 notes for this version that "How to perform version negotiation is left as future work" — so version 1 offers no downgrade-proof negotiation.
en.history: RFC 9000 and its companion RFC 9001 are both May 2021 Standards Track documents (edited by Iyengar and Thomson, and by Thomson and Turner respectively); neither header carries an Updates or Obsoletes line, and the document defines version 1 of QUIC.

zh: UDP 数据报：QUIC 包的承载方式。
传输参数：与密码学参数一并协商的 QUIC 参数。
Initial 密钥：握手初期使用的密钥，需按时丢弃。
Retry 包：带完整性保护，便于服务器验证来源并剔除偶发损坏的包。
版本协商包：不受密码学保护的版本协商。
定制分帧：QUIC 保护数据包所用的帧格式。
en: UDP datagrams: the carrier for QUIC packets.
Transport parameters: negotiated alongside cryptographic ones.
Initial keys: early handshake keys that must be discarded.
Retry packet: integrity protected so a server can validate its origin and drop accidentally corrupted packets.
Version Negotiation packet: unprotected version negotiation.
Custom framing: the packet protection framing QUIC uses.
